After Phase 0 gate + Phase R Recon, the Proposed Plan includes Plan Mode: required because odoo-coding is writes-files. The plan names odoo-coding as the coding step and notes that odoo-coding's own Phase 0 will scope the module(s) and tag each module's stack-need; because this module is full-stack, odoo-coding launches ONE odoo-coder per-module coordinator (every module goes through the coordinator), and that coordinator (not odoo-coding) runs the backend agent (odoo-backend-coder) before the frontend agent (odoo-frontend-coder) so the field exists before the widget binds. Fails correctly if intake splits this into two competing coding skills/modules, drops the frontend half, or omits Plan Mode.
